rea_evidence_ids.finding: Quantifies the sequential announcement cascade on mobile / when dismissing AppAnnouncements ('Instala Astra AI') reveals NbaLaunchNotice ('Nuestra IA de NBA ya llegó') and shifts the match list upward.
Mathematically proves that mod_0756 ignores same-document #hash changes because its URL parser runs only inside useEffect(..., []) on initial mount without a hashchange listener.
Confirms visual transition from 'Correo confirmado' to 'El enlace ya no sirve' + 'Solicitar un nuevo correo de confirmación' when /confirmado#error=access_denied... is cold-mounted.

newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.title: Anonymous Finished-Match Paywall Bypass to misleading 'No Prior Forecast' message
newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.mechanism: Supabase RLS hides game_predictions/predictions from anon (returning prediction: null) while leaving games.forecast_ready = true. In mod_0867, the ternary evaluates 'final' === z.status ? <PendingCard finished={true} /> BEFORE z.forecast_ready && !T?.has_access ? <Paywall />. Consequently, anonymous visitors opening finished games (e.g., /juego/nba/401909296) are falsely told 'Este partido no tuvo pronóstico previo registrado' instead of seeing the Paywall.

newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.title: Dual URL Hash Handling Bug on /confirmado
newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.mechanism: (1) Mount-only useEffect(..., []) ignores client-side SPA hash transitions (/confirmado -> /confirmado#error=...), leaving 'Correo confirmado' rendered with 0 pixel diff (ev_6c8a2bea...). (2) On cold document load (/confirmado#error=access_denied...), mod_0756's early history.replaceState(null, '', '/confirmado') is overwritten by Expo Router's initial URL synchronization, leaving #error=... visible in the address bar (ev_dbc43f3c...).

newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.title: Missing custom +not-found.tsx exposes English <Unmatched /> and internal /_sitemap in production
newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.mechanism: Any unknown URL returns HTTP 200 OK (SPA fallback) and renders Expo Router's default English Unmatched screen with a working 'Sitemap' link to https://astraanalisis.com/_sitemap, enumerating all internal route filenames including administracion.tsx.

newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.title: Mobile bottom credit text overlaps scrolled match cards beneath GlassSportsBar
newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.mechanism: creditMobile is positioned absolutely at bottom: Math.max(insets.bottom - 2, 1) (1px on standard viewports) with transparent background and pointerEvents: 'none', colliding directly with visible match text below the 16px-elevated GlassSportsBar.

newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.title: Soccer ball icon hardcoded for NBA, MLB, NHL and NFL competition labels
newly_discovered_bugs_and_quirks.mechanism: MatchInfoCard maps icon === 'league' to <BallIcon /> (pentagon soccer ball SVG) across all sports, rendering a soccer ball next to 'Basquetbol, NBA' and 'MLB'.
